archive.verification: Official GitHub release asset SHA256 digest independently retrieved from vendor API; archive checksum verified before extraction.

integration: Static PIC libngtcp2 and TLS crypto archives embedded in each libcurl. OpenSSL remains runtime TLS backend for OpenSSL variant; GnuTLS remains backend for GnuTLS variant. No ngtcp2 runtime package, shared library, RPATH or loader override is shipped.
validation: Linux build, upstream check, ABI/feature and final-image gates are required in consumer hosted CI; not run locally.
advisory_scope: Both published vendor advisories have fixed versions <=1.22.1, earlier than1.25.0. This is a vendor advisory applicability pass, not complete all-source scan clearance. Embedded component receipts must be retained in final image inventory.

nghttp3_test_only.verification: SHA256 matches official GitHub release asset digest retrieved from releases/latest API
nghttp3_test_only.advisories: Vendor public security-advisories API returned no advisories at review; not complete scanner clearance.

ordinary_http3_fixture.test: Both staged curl CLI variants must complete ordinary local CA-verified --http3-only transfer, byte-equal body and %{http_version}=3. Separate upstream core/crypto make check required.
ordinary_http3_fixture.scope: Builder-only server and newer static fixture nghttp3, never ship or use for runtime curl linking. Runtime curl still resolves original distro nghttp3 ABI. No local Linux test run.
